response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) as margin FROM telescopes t WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.observstation HAVING AVG(t.bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in bandusagepct represent missing data and are excluded from both station averages and the global average calculation.
